meta.description: P4 sourced 1900 demography of the province world (D-124, D-142): per province the sourced Gapminder values, the fertility level and child/adult mortality multipliers of the WPP 1950 world standard schedule that reproduce them in the game's life table, and the stable age structure of those rates; per block the urban share; per 1900 country the population-weighted source targets. Generated by scripts/p4/build-demography-1900.mjs; do not edit.
meta.method: fertility level = TFR / standard TFR; child multiplier solves under-5 mortality; adult multiplier then solves life expectancy; age structure = stable population (Lotka r) of these rates; urban people of a province go first to its non-peasant blocks (HYDE 3.3 urban share).

acceptanceTolerances.note: Crude birth rates are compared with Gapminder where it has a value; the game's rate is the stable-population rate of the sourced TFR and life expectancy, so differences show the inconsistency between Gapminder's separately estimated series (and of migration-shaped age structures such as the United States and Argentina). Crude death rates have no open 1900 per-country source (D-142 §2): the target is the rate implied by the sourced life expectancy and under-5 mortality in the stable population.

meta.p7: Blocks' urban shares by settlement order (P7, D-154; scripts/p7/labour-build.mjs blockUrbanShares): a province's urban people go to its urban professions first, then by-job, then rural.
